scripts.dev: npm install --prefix ./next-js --silent && npm run nextpress-install && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up --watch --build --menu=0 next-js wordpress ready-check && npm run stop
scripts.start: npm run nextpress-install && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml up --build next-js wordpress ready-check
scripts.nextpress-install: cd next-js && npx nextpress-install && cd ../wp/wp-content/themes/nextpress_theme && composer install --quiet
